transcript: Khatoon, 38 saal, sirf follow up ke liye aayi hain. Pichhli dawai se koi rash nahi hua, koi side effect nahi. Bukhar nahi, khansi nahi. Penicillin se allergy hai, is liye Augmentin nahi deni. Zyrtec aadhi goli raat ko, das din. Ek mahine baad dikhayein.

medications.name: Zyrtec
medications.instructions: continue for one month, review in one month
